chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Whoever fasts on Friday with patience and seeking reward, he will be given the reward of fasting ten bright, shining days, which do not resemble the days of this world.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for fasting on Friday with patience and sincerity?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) highlights the unique spiritual elevation of Friday, noting that fasting on this day with patience (*sabr*) and sincere intention (*ihtisab*) grants the reward of ten 'bright' days (*ghurr*) that are distinct from ordinary time. This emphasizes the Shia emphasis on the intrinsic sanctity of Friday as a day of cosmic significance, where acts of worship carry multiplied merit due to the day's special status in the divine calendar.
